topic.title: Education: A boy teaches other street children to read
topic.focus: A boy teaches other street children to read

candidate_instructions: Read all five sections. Answer Questions 1-5. Follow the stated word limits exactly.

sections.heading: A boy learns to read
sections.text: In 2014, Amit is 12 years old. He lives on the streets in India. A kind teacher finds him. She teaches him to read and write. After one year, Amit can read simple books. He is very happy.

sections.heading: Amit becomes a teacher
sections.text: Now Amit wants to help other street children. In 2017, he starts teaching under a big tree. Five children come. He teaches them the alphabet. He teaches them to read simple words. The children are eager to learn.

sections.heading: More and more children
sections.text: After six months, 20 children sit under the tree every day. Amit teaches them for two hours. He does not have books, but he writes on the ground with a stick. The children learn well. They are happy and excited.

sections.heading: Help and support
sections.text: A school near the tree gives Amit chalk and paper. They give him old books too. Now Amit has better tools. The principal comes and watches. She is very impressed. She offers Amit a job as a teaching assistant.

sections.heading: A new future
sections.text: Today, Amit works at the school. He teaches street children in the morning and afternoon. He earns money for food and a small room. Amit says reading changed his life. Now he changes other children's lives. One book can open many doors.

passage.full_text:
Paragraph 1 — A boy learns to read
In 2014, Amit is 12 years old. He lives on the streets in India. A kind teacher finds him. She teaches him to read and write. After one year, Amit can read simple books. He is very happy.

Paragraph 2 — Amit becomes a teacher
Now Amit wants to help other street children. In 2017, he starts teaching under a big tree. Five children come. He teaches them the alphabet. He teaches them to read simple words. The children are eager to learn.

Paragraph 3 — More and more children
After six months, 20 children sit under the tree every day. Amit teaches them for two hours. He does not have books, but he writes on the ground with a stick. The children learn well. They are happy and excited.

Paragraph 4 — Help and support
A school near the tree gives Amit chalk and paper. They give him old books too. Now Amit has better tools. The principal comes and watches. She is very impressed. She offers Amit a job as a teaching assistant.

Paragraph 5 — A new future
Today, Amit works at the school. He teaches street children in the morning and afternoon. He earns money for food and a small room. Amit says reading changed his life. Now he changes other children's lives. One book can open many doors.
